test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The speed of wind during a storm is 10⁵ mm per sec. How long (in seconds) will it take a dust particle suspended in air to travel 1 km?
solution:
Given:

The speed of wind during a storm is 105 mm per sec.

The distance needed to be traveled = 1 km

Concept used:

Distance = Speed × Time

1 km = 10⁶ mm

Calculation:

Speed = 10⁵ mm per second 

1 km = 106 mm

Time taken by a dust particle suspended in air = Distance/Speed 

⇒ 106 /105

⇒ 10 sec

**∴ It will take 10 seconds for a dust particle suspended in air to travel 1 km.**
